name: Steadfast
description: The Venator-class Star Destroyer Steadfast was utilized by the Galactic Republic's Open Circle Fleet, within its naval branch, during the time of the Clone Wars. By the time of 21 BBY, during the war, the Star Destroyer was constructed for Republic deployment, where it was later employed as the flagship of Jedi General Eeth Koth and his fleet. Later, in 21 BBY, following the Republic's second invasion of the planet Geonosis, numerous attacks had been conducted against Outer Rim Territories hyperspace routes. Resolute to locate the conspirator behind the attacks, Koth traveled aboard the Steadfast through the Saleucami system, where he was ambushed by a Separatist Alliance fleet commanded by General Grievous, who had intended to capture the Jedi Master.
